Docs.summary: Represents an immutable snapshot of GPU work recorded by a Graphite recorder, ready to be inserted into a Graphite context.

remarks.format:
## Remarks
A recording is produced by <xref:SkiaSharp.SKGraphiteRecorder.Snap> and consumed by <xref:SkiaSharp.SKGraphiteContext.InsertRecording(SkiaSharp.SKGraphiteRecording)>. It wraps a native Skia resource and implements <xref:System.IDisposable>; dispose it once it has been inserted.
